text: What is TSN, in this book's terms?
choices: Bounded latency and zero congestion loss added to Ethernet — the packet-versus-circuit argument returning for industrial control, automotive and professional audio
explanation: Scheduled traffic, time synchronisation and frame preemption. Whether it stays specialised or becomes general is genuinely open: the book's pattern suggests general-purpose absorbs specialised, and the counterargument is that hard real-time may be one of the things that cannot be absorbed.
